offering_description.value: Provides investment management and advisory services through mutual funds, closed-end funds, separately managed accounts and private funds, sold to individual investors, institutions and pension plans. Earns fees on assets under management.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; closed-end funds; separately managed accounts; private funds

primary_services.value: investment management; investment advisory; fund administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: institutional investors, corporate pension plans, endowments, foundations; B2C: individual investors holding funds and managed accounts; B2G: public pension plans

end_markets.value: investment management; retirement and pension investing; individual wealth management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: asset management fees on client assets, plus performance-based incentive fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: manages portfolios for funds and accounts, paid fees by funds and clients

geography_served.value: US national: mainly US investors, with some clients in Europe and Asia through offshore funds

specialization.value: related lines: mutual funds, closed-end funds, separately managed accounts and private funds

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: broker-dealers and fund platforms selling fund shares to investors; direct sales: institutional sales staff serving pension plans and consultants

regulatory_exposure.value: high: SEC-registered investment adviser under the Investment Advisers Act and Investment Company Act of 1940
